tauCetiIntegralReduction.sourceEntryProgress: For the original specified positive CM Hermitian form, the actual attached adelic lattices are finite free of full rational rank and recover their original adelic and local lattice regions. A fixed positive integer gives positive integral trace forms. Native trace-dual bases and density prove uniform dual-lattice containment and hence a uniform Gram determinant bound. Adapted proved integral reduction yields finite actual Gram classes; original complex embeddings bound the original CM scalar actions, and adapted finite integral sublevels give finitely many joint action invariants. Equality of the invariants recovers an original field-linear Hermitian isometry and a rational unitary matrix carrying one actual lattice onto the other. Density then recovers the actual integral adelic level. The original unitary arithmetic double-coset quotient is therefore finite at the integral level, and compactness transfers finiteness to every original open level. The existing finite-freeness, coinvariant and exact unnormalized auxiliary trace comparison now derives arithmetic class finiteness instead of assuming it. The original prescribed Frobenius class can be realized outside every finite set of original places with arbitrarily large original rational residue characteristic. The same size bound implies [K(zeta_p):K] exceeds the required rank. Kernel noncontainment of the two original continuous Galois maps yields simultaneous trivial first Frobenius image, nontrivial second image, absolute unramifiedness and the cyclotomic degree restriction. Applied to the specified positive definite CM form, this constructs an actual compact open principal unitary level with trivial arithmetic stabilizers and finite original arithmetic double cosets at that prime. The cyclotomic map is now constructed from the actual primitive root and its established continuity; source root noncontainment in the fixed field of the residual kernel proves the required kernel separation.
